scope: The seven-column Apps launcher shows larger icons and four complete rows in a taller frame.

checks.command: Install the shared launcher in each edition of a disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland guest, verify the installed MenuRepresentation.qml against the approved source, open Applications in light and dark mode and measure its frame using KWin. All four frames measured 1028 by 634 logical pixels.

coverage_limits: Rendered checks cover both editions on KDE neon Wayland at 2x display scale.
